title: One-pot CuI/L-proline-catalysed multicomponent synthesis of pyrido[2′,1′:2,3]imidazo[4,5-c]quinoline derivatives from 2-(2-bromophenyl)imidazo[1,2-a]pyridines, NH3 and DMSO under air
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46951-46958
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06789H, Paper

Ban Van Phuc, Dinh Thi Thuy, Phuong Anh Dao, Van Loc Nguyen, Van Ha Nguyen, Hung Huy Nguyen, Dang Van Do, Hien Nguyen, Tran Quang Hung, Tuan Thanh Dang
Pyrido[2′,1′:2,3]imidazo[4,5-c]quinolines (PIQs) were prepared from 2-(2-bromophenyl)imidazo[1,2-a]pyridines, NH3 and DMSO via a tandem process including CuI/L-proline-catalysed C–N coupling and aerobic oxidative cyclization steps.
